QuestInfo.name: [Temple of Time] Lost Memory
QuestInfo.0: I defeated #o8220004# as #p2140000# told me to, but strangely, I can't go past #m270010500#.  Something doesn't seem right... I should go ask #b#p2140000##k.
QuestInfo.1: Whale of Time, #o8220004#, eats memory as its staple food.  #p2140000# said that my memory was eaten by #o8220004# while I was fighting it and therefore I couldn't pass through Memory Lane .  He said I might be able to retrieve my lost memory if I go see #b#p2140001##k, the Memory Keeper.

0.0: What is it? What? You can't go past #m270010500#? That doesn't sound right... There's nothing wrong with the permission. Hm... Then... the problem must be with you. What kind of problem?

yes.0: The Whale of Time, #o8220004#, lives in Memory Lane and eats memories for sustenance. A part of your memory must have been eaten by #o8220004# while you were fighting it. Because of your lost memory, you can't pass through Memory Lane .
yes.1: You won't be able to pass through Memory Lane until you find your lost memory. But you already destroyed #o8220004#, who ate your memory... You have no choice but to seek help from #p2140001#. #b#p2140001##k... He is the one who sees all memories with the purity of his heart.  He'll probably know what to do about your lost memory.

no.0: If you don't think it's a big deal, then that's fine. You just can't go beyond Memory Lane . Does that work for you?

1.0: ...You are... empty. There is a hole in your heart that used be filled with a memory. Now it's just empty.

npc.0: You still didn't find #b#p2140001##k? He is at a #b#m270010111##k, somewhere on Memory Lane .
